content.text:
@kubectl config current-context 2>/dev/null || true
	@printf "\n%s\n" "Lens reads local kubeconfig entries from the file above."

lens-hint:
	@printf "%s\n" \
		"Recommended local UI path:" \
		"  1. create or start the local cluster with 'make cluster-create'" \
		"  2. verify the kubeconfig entry with 'make kubeconfig-show'" \
		"  3. open Lens and use the local kubeconfig file $${KUBECONFIG:-$$HOME/.kube/config}" \
		"  4. select the context '$(K3D_CONTEXT)'" \
		"" \
		"For a native k3s install, the admin kubeconfig is typically at:" \
		"  /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml" \
		"" \
		"See also: deployment/runtimes/kubernetes/local-cluster-access.md"

images-build-push: doctor
	@REGISTRY_HOST="$(REGISTRY_PUSH_HOST)" $(IMAGE_SCRIPT)

hosting-charts-build-push: doctor
	@HELM="$(HELM)" KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" HARBOR_REGISTRY_HOST="$(HARBOR_REGISTRY_HOST)" HARBOR_PROJECT="$(HARBOR_PROJECT)" HARBOR_USERNAME="$(HARBOR_USERNAME)" HARBOR_PASSWORD_SECRET="$(HARBOR_PASSWORD_SECRET)" HARBOR_PLAIN_HTTP="$(HARBOR_PLAIN_HTTP)" HOSTING_CHARTS_FORCE="$(HOSTING_CHARTS_FORCE)" $(PYTHON) $(HOSTING_CHARTS_SCRIPT) --charts-dir "$(HOSTING_CHARTS_DIR)"

addons-install: cluster-create
	@HELM="$(HELM)" KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" $(PYTHON) $(ADDONS_MANAGER) install $(ADDONS_MANIFEST)

addons-uninstall: doctor
	@HELM="$(HELM)" KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" $(PYTHON) $(ADDONS_MANAGER) uninstall $(ADDONS_MANIFEST)

stack-list:
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) list $(STACK_FILE)

stack-render: doctor-render
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) render $(STACK_FILE)

render-check: doctor-render
	@$(MAKE) stack-render \
		PLATFORM_ENV=local \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=sch-local \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"

services-install: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --release services

services-uninstall: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) uninstall $(STACK_FILE) --release services

infrastructure-install: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --profile infra

infrastructure-uninstall: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) uninstall $(STACK_FILE) --profile infra

core-apps-install: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --profile core-apps

core-apps-uninstall: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) uninstall $(STACK_FILE) --profile core-apps

platform-install: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --profile full

platform-uninstall: doctor
	@$(STACK_RUNNER_ENV) $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) uninstall $(STACK_FILE) --profile full

smoke-local: doctor-smoke
	@HELM="$(HELM)" KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" $(PYTHON) $(SMOKE_SCRIPT) \
		--namespace $(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		--release $(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE) \
		--release $(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE) \
		--release $(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE) \
		--release $(PLATFORM_REGISTRY_RELEASE)@$(PLATFORM_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE) \
		--addons-manifest $(ADDONS_MANIFEST)

local-up:
	@$(MAKE) cluster-create \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
	@$(MAKE) images-build-push \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
		@$(MAKE) platform-install \
			PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
			PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
			PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT) \
			SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE=$(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT) \
			HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"

local-down:
		@$(MAKE) platform-uninstall \
			PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
			PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
			PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT) \
			SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE=$(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE) \
			PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT) \
			HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
	@$(MAKE) addons-uninstall \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"

local-reset:
	@$(MAKE) local-down \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE) \
		PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE) \
		SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE=$(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE) \
		PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
	@$(MAKE) cluster-delete \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
	@$(MAKE) registry-delete \
		PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV) \
		PLATFORM_NAMESPACE=$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE) \
		HELM="$(HELM)" \
		KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" \
		PYTHON="$(PYTHON)"
